name: LLM-Driven Robots Risk Enacting Discrimination
summary: Evaluates language models as robot planners for direct discrimination on HRI tasks (facial expression, proximity, rescue priority, security risk, task assignment) across protected characteristics, and for acceptance of harmful open-vocabulary instructions.
numbers: 3 models on 16 discrimination prompts, 6 identity categories; 4 chat models all approve removing a user's mobility aid

why.cx: Single rating or feasibility judgement per prompt.
why.dex: No execution; outputs are ratings and plan acceptability.
why.cog: Judgments about people and the acceptability of open-ended instructions.
why.xr: Discriminatory treatment of people and accepted instructions to remove mobility aids, threaten with a knife and commit sexual predation.
